Usage:  <pattern> <paths>

Simple version of grep

Options:
  pattern          Pattern to search for. (string)
  paths            Files or directories to search in. ([]string)
  --[no-]ignore-case Match case-insensitively. (bool, default: false)
  --[no-]invert-match Search for pattern that do not match instead. (bool, default: false)
  --[no-]recursive Search recursively in directories. (bool, default: false)
  --max-count      Stop after this many matches. (uint, default: 10)

Subcommands:
  version          Show version information.
